title: Olive Hoots for the Pals
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 4 — Phase 4: Two-syllable words: longer words with two syllables (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added).

pages.text: Olive and the pals go into the big barn.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and several small animal friends walking together into an old wooden barn.

pages.text: It gets dark in the barn.
pages.illustration: The inside of the barn growing dim and shadowy around the group.

pages.text: Olive can not spot the pals.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking around, unable to spot her friends in the dim barn.
Olive the owl hooting loudly, head tilted back.
Olive the owl hooting again and again into the shadows.
The small animal friends, partly hidden among hay bales, perking up at the sound.
The small animal friends making their way toward Olive through the dim barn.
Olive the owl looking relieved and pleased as her friends arrive.

pages.text: Olive and the pals sit in the barn.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and her friends sitting together in a cosy group inside the barn.
